MonoBrowser 0.7.1

- Tab sleep: choose after how long inactive tabs go to sleep (or turn it off) and add sites that never sleep — in Settings or from the tab menu
- Windows: native window controls (minimize / maximize / close) now sit in a framed corner; in the vertical layout they float over the page and auto-hide until you hover the top-right corner (can be turned off in Settings)
- Vertical layout no longer shows the top URL bar, giving the page more vertical space
- The line under the tab strip now runs all the way to the right edge
- Smoother animations: tabs slide when opened, closed, moved, pinned and unpinned, and the active-tab indicator glides between tabs; choose Full, Subtle or Off in Settings
- Pin extensions to the toolbar
- Fixed menus and popups not reacting to clicks in the vertical layout on Windows
- Fixed the vertical tab list overflowing with many tabs
- Tab drag & drop and extension popup fixes
- Updated dependencies (Electron 45.2.3)

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.7.1.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.7.1-x86_64.AppImage`
